newsitem.title: USA: "Change the World" wins best record Grammy.
newsitem.headline: "Change the World" wins best record Grammy.

text.p: "Change the World," sung by Eric Clapton and produced by Kenneth "Babyface" Edmunds, won best record of the year at the U.S. music industry's Grammy Awards ceremony on Wednesday.

"Change the World" also earned songwriters Gordon Kennedy, Wayne Kirkpatrick and Tommy Sims a Grammy for best song of the year, and Clapton won a Grammy for best male pop vocal performance for his rendition of the song, a blend of rhythm and blues and rock.
